title: Surgical Documentation Markup-Modeling 1 [Retrospective Study]
summary: Surgical patients often undergo several abdominal operations during their lifetime. The aim of the retrospective study SDM-M 1 is to investigate whether multiple or particularly extensive procedures influence the course of subsequent operations. To this end, a retrospective, single-center study design will examine completed cases of pancreatic and esophageal surgery as well as operations for bowel obstruction to determine whether previous operations in the course of the affected patients' lives have an influence on the course of these index operations.
conditions: Impact of previous abdominal surgery on the course of subsequent visceral surgery

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of patients who underwent complex pancreatic resection, esophageal resection, or laparotomy for bowel obstruction by the end of 2025. Arm 1: Patients with more than one previous abdominal surgery

Retrospective analysis of patients who underwent complex pancreatic resection, esophageal resection, or laparotomy for bowel obstruction by the end of 2025. Arm 2: Patients with a maximum of one previous abdominal surgery
